subject: a quiet room with translucent paper screens and a low timber platform
pose: diagonal view toward the diffuse daylight
art_direction: 纸屏室内以低木台和浅灰软垫构成安静角落，冬日漫射光在上方保持大块留白。

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a quiet room with translucent paper screens and a low timber platform. Keep the platform and cushions low, with one simple ceramic object at the edge. The paper screens fill the upper fifth as a smooth luminous field without visible writing. Render subtle frame joints, fabric weave, and cool floor shadows. Avoid people, hanging decorations, or a dense collection of objects. Use soft atmospheric interior painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
